SELECT COUNT(*) as over_fragmented_count
FROM core c
JOIN content_info ci ON c.content_key = ci.content_key
WHERE 
  -- More than 6 nested genre categories
  (regexp_count(c.genreclass->>'Hierarchical_Genres', '[~|]') + 1) > 6
  AND
  -- Short clips (Clips_Total + Film_Clips) exceed long-form (Feature_Films)
  CAST(ci.mediacounts->'content_volumes'->>'Clips_Total' AS integer) + 
  CAST(ci.mediacounts->'content_volumes'->>'Film_Clips' AS integer) > 
  CAST(ci.mediacounts->'content_volumes'->>'Feature_Films' AS integer);
